description: Update a persona library image tag, description, or primary flag.

description.description: New description (empty or whitespace-only clears the stored value; omit to keep it)

id.description: The library image ID to update

isPrimary.description: Set true to mark this image as the primary library image (the swap atomically demotes the old primary; false is rejected — mark another image instead)

tag.description: New tag (empty or whitespace-only clears the stored value; omit to keep it)

name: update_persona_image
